## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
A WhatsApp settings page titled "Username" with a back chevron. Center-top: a WhatsApp-green vector illustration - a paper plane, two @ rings, a waving hand, and a smiley clustered together. Below: "Usernames are coming soon. Reserve yours today.", then two bullets ("Your username will keep your phone number private from people who don't already know it.", "You can add a key to control who contacts you by your username.") with a "Learn more" link.

## Motion spec
Pattern: gentle looping idle animation on a vector illustration.
- The cluster floats as one group: a slow vertical bob (+/-8px, 3s ease-in-out loop) with a barely-there rotation (+/-2deg) - like it is suspended in water.
- Individual elements drift against the group on offset phases: the plane slides a few px side to side (2.4s), the smiley bobs at 2.8s, the hand rocks gently (+/-4deg, 3.2s) - the offsets keep the cluster organic.
- The @ rings pulse softly (scale 1 -> 1.05 -> 1, 3.5s) - they are the subject of the page, so they breathe a touch louder.
- The loop runs continuously, seamless, never resetting visibly.
- All copy and the page chrome stay perfectly still - only the illustration is alive.

## Calibration
- Idle means idle: no element should draw the eye by speed - everything moves at reading pace.
- The illustration holds WhatsApp green only - no new colors in motion.

## Reduced motion
The illustration sits completely still.

## Don't miss
- The copy's job is privacy reassurance ("keep your phone number private") - the calm animation supports it; nothing should feel urgent.
- "Learn more" is a quiet text link, not a button.
